posts.name: EvanDan55
posts.cooked:
A little late to the conversation, but my first hero was Tempest as well. I was at Gen Con 2011 and hadn't played any games there for about two days (my first time going and not a board gamer at the time). I'm sitting down when Paul ran up to my friends and me, saying "Hey, anyone want to demo a game? We need one more person." I said sure, and now here I am.

Just like Andy, I checked out their Facebook page later that night and saw the pictures with captions like "Finally, the reveal of our special card! Young Legacy!" I had the same thought of "Oh that's cute. They're making a big deal about these reveals on a page with ~100 fans. At least they're trying. Maybe I'll play this game a few times, but I'll probably get sick of these four villains."

Flash forward five years...

"I've still got to make plans for my Void Guard Idealist cosplay, talk to Craig about working the whole of Gen Con for them, playtest that new material, discuss Foote's latest theory on the forums, make Becky Blast into my next pen & paper RPG character, and meet up with my friends later to continue our Advanced-Challenge-Mode-Flawless-Victory campaign tonight!"

Awesome story.

My first was Ra, back in 2012. One of my friends brought the game to game night, and we played a 4 player game. I fell in love with it. I thought it could be the game that could give me my superhero gaming fix. Then he didn't bring it back for 2 years, and it fell off my radar…

Fast forward to 2014. He asked what games he could bring, and a vague recollection of liking the game prompt me to suggest SotM. He did bring it back, I played Ra yet again, and fell back in love with the game. This time, I bought a copy of the game myself. The rest, as they say, is history.
